note: The artifact draw model: which substats a piece is created with, and which main stat a slot rolls. THIS IS NOT DERIVED FROM THE PINNED GAME DATA, and that is why it lives in app/data/external/ rather than app/data/yuanshen/snapshot/. Measured 2026-09-05 against the AnimeGameData capture at 5445617e33b2: ReliquaryAffixExcelConfigData (350 rows) carries id/propType/group_id/propValue/depotId and no weight; ReliquaryMainPropExcelConfigData (66 rows) carries id/propDepotId/propType/affixName and no weight. ReliquaryExcelConfigData does have a `weight`, and it is an item-drop weight on the artifact entry (weight: 1) -- taking it because the key matched would be confidently wrong. So these numbers are a NAMED SECONDARY SOURCE, shipped openly the way gcsim_config.ENERGY_DRIP already is. See docs/DESIGN_artifact_ranking.md section 8.3 and docs/RESEARCH_substat_draw_weights.md.

sources.what: the origin that file itself cites, in its own first comment
sources.note: Community-maintained. Not independently verified here; see the caveat field.

caveat: These weights could not be confirmed against the owner's own 2,370-artifact export. Inclusion probability under a weighted draw without replacement is monotone in weight, and on flowers at +0 the observed ordering violates that -- critDMG_ (w=3) above atk (w=6), with hp_ and def_ (w=4) last. Either a kept inventory is still selected at +0 or the published table is wrong. That is a measurement, not a correction: nothing here is adjusted to fit the export. docs/RESEARCH_substat_draw_weights.md.

domain_drops.note: What one Domain of Blessing claim (20 resin) yields at Adventure Rank 45+, for docs/DESIGN_upgrade_estimator.md. Community-compiled and community-measured, never published by HoYoverse. docs/RESEARCH_artifact_drop_model.md sections 1-4 carry the reading of every source.

five_star_per_run_source.what: Predicted mean 1.065 five-star artifacts per claim at AR 45+, with at least one guaranteed; measured 1.07 over 14,088 runs by the Genshin Data Gathering Team.

domain_drops.five_star_count_shape: ASSUMED: 1 + Bernoulli(five_star_per_run - 1). Only means are published (RESEARCH_artifact_drop_model_followup.md item 1). The shape barely moves the answer: r = q * E[N] - O(q^2).

four_line_share_source.what: A domain 5-star starts with 4 substats 20% of the time and 3 substats 80% of the time (bosses, Strongbox and Abyss are 34%, not used here). Confirmed by the owner, 2026-10-24.

set_share_source.what: A domain's 5-star drops are split 1/2 between its two sets.

slot_share_source.what: Each of the five slots is equally likely.

sets_without_domain_five_star.what: Nanoka set ids no Domain of Blessing drops at 5 stars. A slot inside one of these sets' active bonus cannot be replaced by any domain drop, so the estimator answers 'never' rather than pricing half the drops.
sets_without_domain_five_star.boss_only_note: Gladiator's Finale and Wanderer's Troupe: 5-star sources are Weekly Bosses, Normal Bosses, Domain Reliquary: Tier I and the Artifact Strongbox, and no domain.
sets_without_domain_five_star.no_five_star_source_note: Sets whose wiki infobox lists no source5 at all: the beginner and 4-star-capped sets, the Prayers sets, and Glacier and Snowfield. Nanoka's `rank` lists 5 for several of these (Instructor reads [1..5]), so `artifact_sets.available_ranks` cannot answer this.
sets_without_domain_five_star.method: Read 2026-10-25: each 5-star-ranked set in the nanoka 7.0.51 catalogue fetched as wikitext from the Genshin Fandom wiki and classified by its `source5.N` infobox fields. A set newer than this list is assumed domain-farmable, which is how every new set has shipped.
